# sfdep

sfdep builds on the great shoulders of spdep package for spatial
dependence. sfdep creates an sf and tidyverse friendly interface to the
package as well as introduces new functionality that is not present in
spdep. sfdep utilizes list columns extensively to make this interface
possible.

## Installation

Install the released version from CRAN

``` r

install.packages("sfdep")
```

You can install the development version of sfdep like so:

``` r

remotes::install_github("josiahparry/sfdep")
```

## Usage

There are three main categories of functionality relating to geometry
neighbors, weights, and local indicators of spatial association (LISAs).

### Neighbors

The most fundamental usage is to find contiguous neighbors from a
polygon. This is done with
[`st_contiguity()`](https://josiahparry.github.io/sfdep/reference/st_contiguity.md)
which, by default creates queen weights. If rook weights are desired,
set `queen = FALSE`. Additional arguments can be passed to the
underlying
[`spdep::poly2nb()`](https://r-spatial.github.io/spdep/reference/poly2nb.html)
via `...`.
[`st_contiguity()`](https://josiahparry.github.io/sfdep/reference/st_contiguity.md)
creates an object of class `nb` as used by `spdep`.

``` r

library(sf)
library(sfdep)
library(dplyr)

# grab geometry
geo <- st_geometry(guerry)

nb <- st_contiguity(geo)

nb
#> Neighbour list object:
#> Number of regions: 85 
#> Number of nonzero links: 420 
#> Percentage nonzero weights: 5.813149 
#> Average number of links: 4.941176
```

We can identify higher order neighbors with
[`st_nb_lag()`](https://josiahparry.github.io/sfdep/reference/st_nb_lag.md)
and the cumulative higher order neighbors with
[`st_nb_lag_cumul()`](https://josiahparry.github.io/sfdep/reference/st_nb_lag_cumul.md).

``` r

st_nb_lag(nb, 2)
#> Neighbour list object:
#> Number of regions: 85 
#> Number of nonzero links: 756 
#> Percentage nonzero weights: 10.46367 
#> Average number of links: 8.894118
st_nb_lag_cumul(nb, 2)
#> Neighbour list object:
#> Number of regions: 85 
#> Number of nonzero links: 1176 
#> Percentage nonzero weights: 16.27682 
#> Average number of links: 13.83529
```

Other point geometry neighbor functions are
[`st_knn()`](https://josiahparry.github.io/sfdep/reference/st_knn.md),
[`st_dist_band()`](https://josiahparry.github.io/sfdep/reference/st_dist_band.md),
[`st_nb_dists()`](https://josiahparry.github.io/sfdep/reference/st_nb_dists.md).

### Weights

Polygon weights are created with
[`st_weights()`](https://josiahparry.github.io/sfdep/reference/st_weights.md)
(which calls
[`spdep::nb2listw`](https://r-spatial.github.io/spdep/reference/nb2listw.html)).
By default they are row standardized weights.

``` r

wt <- st_weights(nb)

wt[1:2]
#> [[1]]
#> [1] 0.25 0.25 0.25 0.25
#> 
#> [[2]]
#> [1] 0.1666667 0.1666667 0.1666667 0.1666667 0.1666667 0.1666667
```

Other point based weights can be created with
[`st_nb_dists()`](https://josiahparry.github.io/sfdep/reference/st_nb_dists.md),
[`st_kernel_weights()`](https://josiahparry.github.io/sfdep/reference/st_kernel_weights.md)
and `st_inverse_weights()`.

### Local Indicators of Spatial Association (LISAs)

LISAs are created from a combination of neighbors and weights and are
intended to be used inside of a dplyr pipeline. The below is a worked
example of calculating the spatial lag and the local moran.

``` r

g <- guerry %>% 
  mutate(
    nb = st_contiguity(geometry),
    wt = st_weights(nb)
    )
```

Then calculate the spatial lag with
[`st_lag()`](https://josiahparry.github.io/sfdep/reference/st_lag.md).
Given that we’ve only modified an sf object, we can visualize this with
ggplot2.

``` r

library(ggplot2)

# create spatial lag
g %>% 
  mutate(crime_pers_lag = st_lag(crime_pers, nb, wt)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(fill = crime_pers_lag)) + 
  geom_sf(lwd = 0.2, color = "black") +
  theme_void()
```

![](reference/figures/README-unnamed-chunk-6-1.png)

Most users will be interested in local indicators of spatial association
(LISA). Utilize
[`local_moran()`](https://josiahparry.github.io/sfdep/reference/local_moran.md)
to do this.
[`local_moran()`](https://josiahparry.github.io/sfdep/reference/local_moran.md)
will create a data frame column which contains a number of informative
variables. For example the cluster that a polygon falls into based on
mean, median, or pysal calculations. This will need to be unnested or
certain variables hoisted.

Create the Local Moran data frame column.

``` r

lisa <- g %>% 
  mutate(moran = local_moran(crime_pers, nb, wt))

pull(lisa, moran) %>% 
  glimpse()
#> Rows: 85
#> Columns: 12
#> $ ii           <dbl> 0.52226452, 0.82801651, 0.80353997, 0.74188966, 0.2311871…
#> $ eii          <dbl> -0.0436664933, 0.0169987175, -0.0106696690, -0.0015410148…
#> $ var_ii       <dbl> 0.3648295427, 0.1244317578, 0.1409560743, 0.2311181704, 0…
#> $ z_ii         <dbl> 0.9369545, 2.2991365, 2.1686743, 1.5464057, 1.1463544, 1.…
#> $ p_ii         <dbl> 0.348781971, 0.021497187, 0.030107416, 0.122006629, 0.251…
#> $ p_ii_sim     <dbl> 0.376, 0.016, 0.036, 0.092, 0.284, 0.124, 0.560, 0.108, 0…
#> $ p_folded_sim <dbl> 0.188, 0.008, 0.018, 0.046, 0.142, 0.062, 0.280, 0.054, 0…
#> $ skewness     <dbl> 0.186247324, -0.166050386, -0.065842084, -0.148874532, 0.…
#> $ kurtosis     <dbl> -0.256988635, -0.083615702, -0.115769407, -0.105166850, 0…
#> $ mean         <fct> High-High, High-High, High-High, Low-Low, Low-Low, Low-Lo…
#> $ median       <fct> High-High, High-High, High-High, Low-Low, Low-Low, Low-Lo…
#> $ pysal        <fct> High-High, High-High, High-High, Low-Low, Low-Low, Low-Lo…
```

Visualize this by converting insignificant values to NA. This uses a
cutoff of 0.1.

``` r

lisa %>% 
  tidyr::unnest(moran) %>% 
  mutate(pysal = ifelse(p_folded_sim <= 0.1, as.character(pysal), NA)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(fill = pysal)) +
  geom_sf() +
  geom_sf(lwd = 0.2, color = "black") +
  theme_void() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#1C4769", "#24975E", "#EACA97", "#B20016"))
```

![](reference/figures/README-unnamed-chunk-8-1.png)

# Package index

## Neighbors

- [`st_contiguity()`](https://josiahparry.github.io/sfdep/reference/st_contiguity.md)
  : Identify polygon neighbors
- [`st_knn()`](https://josiahparry.github.io/sfdep/reference/st_knn.md)
  : Calculate K-Nearest Neighbors
- [`st_dist_band()`](https://josiahparry.github.io/sfdep/reference/st_dist_band.md)
  : Neighbors from a distance band
- [`st_block_nb()`](https://josiahparry.github.io/sfdep/reference/st_block_nb.md)
  : Create Block Contiguity for Spatial Regimes
- [`st_nb_delaunay()`](https://josiahparry.github.io/sfdep/reference/st_nb_delaunay.md)
  [`st_nb_gabriel()`](https://josiahparry.github.io/sfdep/reference/st_nb_delaunay.md)
  [`st_nb_relative()`](https://josiahparry.github.io/sfdep/reference/st_nb_delaunay.md)
  : Graph based neighbors
- [`st_complete_nb()`](https://josiahparry.github.io/sfdep/reference/st_complete_nb.md)
  : Create Neighbors as Complete Graph
- [`st_nb_lag()`](https://josiahparry.github.io/sfdep/reference/st_nb_lag.md)
  : Pure Higher Order Neighbors
- [`st_nb_lag_cumul()`](https://josiahparry.github.io/sfdep/reference/st_nb_lag_cumul.md)
  : Encompassing Higher Order Neighbors
- [`st_cardinalties()`](https://josiahparry.github.io/sfdep/reference/st_cardinalties.md)
  : Calculate neighbor cardinalities
- [`cond_permute_nb()`](https://josiahparry.github.io/sfdep/reference/cond_permute_nb.md)
  : Conditional permutation of neighbors

## Weights

- [`st_weights()`](https://josiahparry.github.io/sfdep/reference/st_weights.md)

## Utility Functions

  : tidyverse methods for spacetime objects
- [`recreate_listw()`](https://josiahparry.github.io/sfdep/reference/recreate_listw.md)
  : Create a listw object from a neighbors and weight list
- [`find_xj()`](https://josiahparry.github.io/sfdep/reference/find_xj.md)
  : Identify xj values
- [`include_self()`](https://josiahparry.github.io/sfdep/reference/include_self.md)
  [`remove_self()`](https://josiahparry.github.io/sfdep/reference/include_self.md)
  : Includes self in neighbor list
- [`wt_as_matrix()`](https://josiahparry.github.io/sfdep/reference/wt_as_matrix.md)
  [`nb_as_matrix()`](https://josiahparry.github.io/sfdep/reference/wt_as_matrix.md)
  : Convert neighbor or weights list to matrix
- [`critical_threshold()`](https://josiahparry.github.io/sfdep/reference/critical_threshold.md)
  : Identify critical threshold
- [`szero()`](https://josiahparry.github.io/sfdep/reference/szero.md) :
  Global sum of weights
- [`pct_nonzero()`](https://josiahparry.github.io/sfdep/reference/pct_nonzero.md)
  : Percent Non-zero Neighbors
- [`nb_union()`](https://josiahparry.github.io/sfdep/reference/nb_union.md)

- [`st_nb_apply()`](https://josiahparry.github.io/sfdep/reference/st_nb_apply.md)
  : Apply a function to neighbors

  : Kernel functions
- [`local_colocation_calc()`](https://josiahparry.github.io/sfdep/reference/local_colocation_calc.md)

  : Identify matches between two neighbor lists

  : Pairwise CLQ calculation

  : Pairwise CLQ conditional permutation implementation
- [`permute_listw()`](https://josiahparry.github.io/sfdep/reference/permute_listw.md)
  : Conditionally permutes a listw object
- [`shuffle_nbs()`](https://josiahparry.github.io/sfdep/reference/shuffle_nbs.md)
  : Internal function to shuffle neighbors
- [`sin_d()`](https://josiahparry.github.io/sfdep/reference/sin_d.md) :
  Trigonometric functions
- [`spt_nb()`](https://josiahparry.github.io/sfdep/reference/spt_nb.md)
  : Create time lagged spatial neighbors
- [`spt_order()`](https://josiahparry.github.io/sfdep/reference/spt_order.md)
  : Order a spacetime cube
- [`spt_wt()`](https://josiahparry.github.io/sfdep/reference/spt_wt.md)
  : Create time lagged spatial weights
